profile.summary: Bay Area Girls Rock Camp is a nonprofit in Oakland that empowers young people through music. It runs a 10-week after-school music program and a weeklong summer music camp for girls, trans and gender-expansive youth. It also offers an Adult Rock Camp and peer mentoring.
